functions.name: Add(event, id, callback)
functions.description: Registers a callback for an event. Supported game events are automatically connected to the game hook dispatcher.

functions.name: Once(event, id, callback)
functions.description: Registers a callback that is removed after its first execution.

functions.name: Exists(event, id)
functions.description: Returns whether a callback with the given event and identifier is registered.

functions.name: Clear(event)
functions.description: Removes all GmExec callbacks registered for the specified event.

functions.name: Run(event, ...)
functions.description: Dispatches an event to GmExec callbacks and returns the first non-nil callback result, if any.

functions.name: Call(event, gamemode, ...)
functions.description: Dispatches an event and falls back to the matching gamemode method if no callback returns a non-nil value.

functions.name: On(event, id, callback)
functions.description: Registers a callback in the native event registry.

functions.name: Once(event, id, callback)
functions.description: Registers a native event callback that runs once.

functions.name: Off(event, id)
functions.description: Removes a native event callback by identifier.

functions.name: Has(event, id)
functions.description: Returns whether the specified native event callback exists.

functions.name: Clear(event)
functions.description: Removes all native callbacks for the specified event.

functions.name: Emit(event, ...)
functions.description: Dispatches an event to callbacks registered in the native event registry.

functions.name: BindGameEvent(event)
functions.description: Connects a game event to the GmExec native event dispatcher when the game hook system is available.

functions.name: RepairBridges()
functions.description: Checks registered game-event relays and re-registers any missing relays.

functions.name: BridgeStatus(event)
functions.description: Returns whether a game-event relay is present and whether it matches the expected relay.

functions.name: version
functions.description: Contains the current native API version string.
